annotations.title: Look up a company's filing deadlines

description: Looks up a company on the Companies House public register by its company number and answers its name, status and type, when its next accounts are due and the period they cover, whether they are overdue, when its next confirmation statement is due, and the type of its last accounts. Use this when the person asks when their company's accounts or confirmation statement are due, whether a filing is overdue, or what the register holds for a company number. It reads the public register only: it needs no DIYA-GL book, and it does not file anything with Companies House.

companyNumber.description: The company number, 8 characters, such as 00006400 or SC123456
